title: Undercurrent probe spec
description: Extraction-point spec for Undercurrent, Wrynx's activation-probing platform: which tensors to capture at which layers and token positions during LLM inference, and which probe consumes them.

extraction_points.title: Extraction Points
extraction_points.description: The extraction points: what to capture during inference and which probe consumes it.

ExecutionMode.description: 'inline': the probe runs on the generation path and can intervene. 'async': the activation is queued and probed off the hot path (trajectory probes only).
ExecutionMode.title: ExecutionMode

ExtractionPointSpec.description: One extraction point: what to capture, where, and which probe consumes it.

name.description: Unique name for this extraction point within the spec file.

layers.description: Layer index (0-based) or a non-empty list of layer indices to capture at.

tensor_type.description: Which tensor to capture at each layer: 'residual_stream' (decoder-layer output), 'attn_out', 'mlp_out', 'kv' (the KV cache), or 'final_norm' (the model's final norm output, after the last decoder layer; distinct from 'residual_stream' at the last layer, which is pre-norm).

position.description:
Which token position(s) to capture. One of:
- an integer (or integer string): absolute index into the full prompt + generated sequence, e.g. 5
- 'prompt[i]': the i-th prompt token; negative counts from the end ('prompt[-1]' is the last prompt token)
- 'generated[i]': the i-th generated token; 'generated[-1]' is the last one
- 'generated[*]': every generated token (continuous)
- 'generated[start:]' or 'generated[start:stop]': generated tokens in [start, stop) (continuous; stop > start)
Any non-integer form may end in an offset such as '+1' or '-2', e.g. 'prompt[-1]+1' (one token past the last prompt token). 'stride' and 'until' only apply to continuous selectors.

stride.description: Only match every Nth position within a continuous position selector ('generated[*]' or a slice). Must be >= 1.

until.description: When a continuous capture stops. Only valid with a continuous position selector.

probe_type.description: Name of the registered probe that consumes these activations, e.g. 'linear_probe'.

probe_kind.description: 'single_shot': the probe sees one activation and returns a result. 'trajectory': the probe keeps state across positions (required for execution_mode 'async').

execution_mode.description: 'inline': the probe runs on the generation path and can intervene. 'async': the activation is queued and probed off the hot path (trajectory probes only).

queue_depth.description: Bounded queue size for this point's async worker. Only valid with execution_mode 'async'; omit it to use the router's default. Must be >= 1.

intervention.description: Intervention policy for this point. Omit it to use the router's default. async points may only use the default (mode 'reject').

probe_args.description: Extra constructor keyword arguments for this point's probe, merged over the router's probe_kwargs (this point wins).

ExtractionPointSpec.title: ExtractionPointSpec

InterventionMode.description: 'reject' (default): no wait-for-decision contract. 'block_until_signal': the router waits up to timeout_ms for the probe before generation proceeds (requires timeout_ms).
InterventionMode.title: InterventionMode

InterventionPolicySpec.description: Intervention policy: whether the router waits for this point's probe before generation proceeds.

mode.description: 'reject' (default): no wait-for-decision contract. 'block_until_signal': the router waits up to timeout_ms for the probe before generation proceeds (requires timeout_ms).

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the probe, in milliseconds (>= 1). Required for, and only valid with, mode 'block_until_signal'.

on_timeout.description: What block_until_signal falls back to when timeout_ms elapses or the probe raises: 'continue' generation or 'abort' it.

InterventionPolicySpec.title: InterventionPolicySpec

ProbeKind.description: 'single_shot': the probe sees one activation and returns a result. 'trajectory': the probe keeps state across positions (required for execution_mode 'async').
ProbeKind.title: ProbeKind
